notes: Clip contract for M2. Artist authors every clip on the shared skeleton at 30 fps in public/assets/art/cats/cat_anims.glb (bone tracks only) and expression curves in cat_expressions.json; Engine binds clips by name. Locomotion is in place with extras.authoredSpeed (m/s at adult scale; the Engine rescales by each cat's leg length); jumps keep root motion. contacts are touchdown phases (0–1) per paw (LF, RF, LH, RH). Event names starting with sfx: are audio event ids from audio/sfx/cat/manifest.json; the behavior phase triggers them and missing files stay silent. Layers: locomotion = speed/turn blend; action = full-body clip; additive = layered over the base pose.

expressions.name: blink
expressions.notes: Quick blink about every 3–8 s (seeded per cat); upper lid moves most.

expressions.name: slow_blink
expressions.notes: Trust signal: slow close, hold about 0.5 s, slow open.

expressions.name: squint_content
expressions.notes: Half-closed eyes while stroked below the threshold.

clips.name: cat.loco.idle
clips.notes: Standing square, weight shifting subtly between fore and hind; slow breathing in ribs (spine_02–04 expansion), occasional ear swivel and tail-tip flick. Head level, gaze forward. Never perfectly still.

clips.name: cat.loco.walk
clips.notes: Lateral-sequence four-beat walk (LH, LF, RH, RF). Duty factor about 0.62. Hind paw lands in or just behind the front paw print (direct register). Shoulder blades rise and fall alternately above the spine; head bobs slightly and stays level; hips roll a little; tail carried low-mid with a gentle S-curve. No equal sine waves: stance is longer than swing and the paw lifts sharply, travels low and sets down softly.

clips.name: cat.loco.trot
clips.notes: Diagonal-pair trot (LH+RF, RH+LF) with brief overlap and no suspension. Spine stays fairly level; head steadier than in walk; tail mid-height, used for balance.

clips.name: cat.loco.gallop
clips.notes: Rotary gallop with gathered (spine flexed, paws under body) and extended (spine fully extended, both suspensions) phases. Strong spine flexion is the engine of the stride; ears back, tail streams out low.

clips.name: cat.loco.turn_left
clips.notes: In-place 90° left turn: head and gaze lead, then shoulders, then pelvis; front paws step around while hind paws pivot. Root rotation is authored (rootRotationDeg) for blending with steering.

clips.name: cat.loco.turn_right
clips.notes: Mirror of turn_left.

clips.name: cat.loco.start
clips.notes: Idle to walk: weight shifts forward, first front paw lifts, head lowers slightly, blends into walk phase 0.

clips.name: cat.loco.stop
clips.notes: Walk to idle: last steps shorten, hind paws come under, head lifts, settles into idle pose.

clips.name: cat.rest.sit_down
clips.notes: Hind end lowers first while front legs stay straight; tail sweeps around to wrap the front paws at the end.

clips.name: cat.rest.sit_idle
clips.notes: Upright sit, front legs vertical, tail wrapped around paws; slow breathing, occasional ear rotation, head tracks slowly.

clips.name: cat.rest.loaf
clips.notes: Bread-loaf: legs tucked under the chest, paws hidden, body compact and rounded, eyes half closed; slow breathing; tail tight to the body.

clips.name: cat.rest.lie_side
clips.notes: Lying on one side, legs relaxed and slightly extended, belly partly exposed, head resting on the floor; slow deep breathing.

clips.name: cat.rest.sprawl
clips.notes: Fully stretched on side or back in warmth (sunbeam): front legs reaching forward, hind legs extended, spine long; very slow breathing; occasional paw twitch.

clips.name: cat.rest.sleep_curl
clips.notes: Curled in a tight ring, nose tucked to the tail, tail covering the nose and paws; very slow breaths (about 20–30 per minute), occasional ear twitch during dreams.

clips.name: cat.rest.wake_stretch
clips.notes: Rises, then the full downward-dog stretch: front legs reach far forward, chest low, hind end high, toes spread; then the hind-leg stretch, one leg extended back. Ends standing.

clips.name: cat.rest.yawn
clips.notes: Head lifts slightly, jaw opens very wide with the tongue curling, eyes squeeze shut, ears rotate back a little, then a small lip lick. Layer over sit or loaf.

clips.name: cat.care.groom_face
clips.notes: Sitting: licks the inside of a front paw, then wipes it over the ear and cheek in repeated strokes; alternate sides between loops.

clips.name: cat.care.groom_flank
clips.notes: Sitting or lying, head turns back over the shoulder to lick the flank with long, rhythmic strokes; front paw braces.

clips.name: cat.care.eat_crouch
clips.notes: Crouched at the bowl, elbows out, head tilted to one side while chewing (cats chew with the side teeth); intermittent pauses.

clips.name: cat.care.drink_lap
clips.notes: Crouched with the head low over water; the tongue laps about four times a second while the head stays still; occasional swallow pause.

clips.name: cat.care.paw_water
clips.notes: Sits by the bowl and dips one front paw into the water, flicks it, then licks the paw (Juniper's habit).

clips.name: cat.care.litter_dig
clips.notes: Standing in the tray, alternating front-paw scoops behind the body; head down, sniffing.

clips.name: cat.care.litter_squat
clips.notes: Hind legs bent, rump low, tail raised and still, body tense, gaze fixed ahead.

clips.name: cat.care.litter_cover
clips.notes: Turns, sniffs, then sweeps litter forward with slow alternating front-paw strokes.

clips.name: cat.care.knead
clips.notes: Alternating front-paw pushes on a soft surface, toes spreading and claws flexing; eyes half closed, purring posture.

clips.name: cat.care.scratch_post
clips.notes: Reaches up the post, both front paws pulling down alternately with claws extended; back arched, hind legs braced.

clips.name: cat.move.jump_up_low
clips.notes: Up to about 0.45 m (a chair seat): crouch and look, hind legs drive, front paws reach for the edge, hind paws land beside them.

clips.name: cat.move.jump_up_high
clips.notes: Up to about 1.2 m (top of the cat tree): longer crouch with tail twitching and gaze measuring the target, explosive hind-leg extension, front paws catch then hind paws scrabble up.

clips.name: cat.move.jump_down_low
clips.notes: Down from about 0.45 m: front paws reach down, body follows, front paws absorb then hind paws land.

clips.name: cat.move.jump_down_high
clips.notes: Down from about 1.2 m: leans over the edge, reaches down with front legs before pushing off, lands front paws first with deep absorption.

clips.name: cat.move.land
clips.notes: Absorbs a landing: front legs flex, chest dips, hind paws come down, recovers to stand.

clips.name: cat.play.pounce
clips.notes: Crouch, short butt wiggle, spring forward and pin with both front paws.

clips.name: cat.play.bat_left
clips.notes: Quick left-forepaw swipe at a small object, claws sheathed, from sit or crouch.

clips.name: cat.play.bat_right
clips.notes: Mirror of bat_left.

clips.name: cat.play.roll_over
clips.notes: Drops onto the side and rolls onto the back, paws relaxed in the air, wriggles, then rolls back. A trust display, not an invitation to touch the belly.

clips.name: cat.social.head_rub
clips.notes: Leans in and rubs the cheek, then the side of the head and the flank along a hand or object; tail up.

clips.name: cat.social.tail_up_greeting
clips.notes: Approaches with the tail vertical and the tip slightly curled, chin up; may trill.

clips.name: cat.social.slow_blink
clips.notes: Eyes close slowly, stay closed briefly, then open slowly; head lowers slightly. A trust signal; the engine also drives blink morphs.

clips.name: cat.react.hiss
clips.notes: Ears flattened sideways, mouth open showing the teeth, body drawn back, weight on the hind legs, hair raised along the spine and tail.

clips.name: cat.react.flinch_startle
clips.notes: Sudden crouch and recoil, eyes wide, ears swivel, then freezes and assesses.

clips.name: cat.react.swat
clips.notes: A fast single forepaw strike toward the hand, then a pull back; ears back.

clips.name: cat.react.walk_away
clips.notes: Walk away offended: a stiffer, faster walk with the tail held low or flicking, ears turned back, without looking back. Locomotion clip used instead of walk while avoiding the hand.

clips.name: cat.layer.tail_up
clips.notes: Tail vertical with a soft tip curl: friendly and confident.

clips.name: cat.layer.tail_low
clips.notes: Tail held low and close to the body: uncertain.

clips.name: cat.layer.tail_lash
clips.notes: Fast side-to-side lashing from the base: overstimulated or irritated (meter 0.6–1.0).

clips.name: cat.layer.tail_flick
clips.notes: Only the last third flicks occasionally: attentive or mildly annoyed.

clips.name: cat.layer.ears_forward
clips.notes: Ears upright and forward: interested.

clips.name: cat.layer.ears_back
clips.notes: Ears rotated back and flattened sideways (airplane): irritated or frightened.

clips.name: cat.layer.ear_twitch
clips.notes: A single quick ear twitch, alternate sides.

clips.name: cat.layer.purr_breath
clips.notes: Slightly deeper, steady breathing in the ribs while purring.

clips.name: cat.layer.skin_twitch
clips.notes: A ripple along the back when touched near the threshold (spine_02–05 small fast rotations).

clips.name: cat.layer.lean_in
clips.notes: Leans the head and body into a stroking hand, eyes half closed.

clips.name: cat.perk.catnip_sniff
clips.notes: Sniffs the toy intently, then the flehmen grimace: mouth slightly open, upper lip raised.

clips.name: cat.perk.catnip_lick
clips.notes: Licks and chews the toy, eyes half closed.

clips.name: cat.perk.catnip_roll
clips.notes: Rolls over and rubs the head, cheeks and body on the toy, wriggling on the back.

clips.name: cat.perk.catnip_zoom
clips.notes: A burst of zoomies: gallop-like sprint loop with sharp turns.

clips.name: cat.perk.laser_stalk
clips.notes: Low crouch stalk: belly near the floor, slow deliberate steps, head level, eyes locked on the dot.

clips.name: cat.perk.laser_butt_wiggle
clips.notes: Pre-pounce hind-end wiggle, hind paws treading.

clips.name: cat.perk.laser_pounce
clips.notes: Pounces on the dot and pins it with both front paws.

clips.name: cat.perk.toy_catch
clips.notes: Session end: catches the physical toy and holds it with the front paws and mouth.

clips.name: cat.perk.feather_bat
clips.notes: Batting at a dangling feather from a sit, alternating paws.

clips.name: cat.perk.feather_leap
clips.notes: Vertical leap with both front paws reaching up.

clips.name: cat.perk.feather_catch
clips.notes: Catches the feather between the front paws and bites it.

clips.name: cat.perk.harness_freeze
clips.notes: First harness: freezes, body low and flat, refuses to move.

clips.name: cat.perk.harness_low_walk
clips.notes: Slinking low walk with the belly near the ground.

clips.name: cat.perk.harness_flop
clips.notes: Flops onto the side and stays down in protest.

clips.name: cat.perk.harness_sniff
clips.notes: Sniffs the ground outdoors, head low, whiskers forward.
